arxiv-2108-12632.title: Diffraction of acoustic waves by a wedge of point scatterers 1 1 1 Submitted to the SIAM Journal on Applied Mathematics on 06/08/2021. Funding: A.V.K. is supported by a Royal Society Dorothy Hodgkin Research Fellowship and a Dame Kathleen Ollerenshaw Fellowship, through which M.A.N. has been funded.
arxiv-2108-12632.creator: M. A. Nethercote, A. V. Kisil and R. C. Assier
arxiv-2108-12632.description: Abstract This article considers the problem of diffraction by a wedge consisting of two semi-infinite periodic arrays of point scatterers. The solution is obtained in terms of two coupled systems, each of which is solved using the discrete Wiener–Hopf technique.

arxiv-2109-14460.title: An Archimedes’ Screw for Light
arxiv-2109-14460.creator: Emanuele Galiffi, Paloma A. Huidobro, J. B. Pendry
arxiv-2109-14460.description: Abstract An Archimedes’ Screw captures water, feeding energy into it by lifting it to a higher level. We introduce the first instance of an optical Archimedes’ Screw, and demonstrate how this system is capable of capturing light, dragging it and amplifying it.

arxiv-2112-01318.title: Omicron (B.1.1.529): Infectivity, vaccine breakthrough, and antibody resistance.
arxiv-2112-01318.creator: Jiahui Chen, Rui Wang, Nancy Benovich Gilby, Guo-Wei Wei
arxiv-2112-01318.description: Abstract The latest severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) variant Omicron (B.1.1.529) has ushered panic responses around the world due to its contagious and vaccine escape mutations. The essential infectivity and antibody resistance of the SARS-CoV-2 variant are determined by its mutations on the spike (S) protein receptor-binding domain (RBD).

arxiv-2112-09066.title: An Interactive Approach for Identifying Structure Definitions
arxiv-2112-09066.creator: Natalia Mikula, Tom Dörffel, Daniel Baum, Hans-Christian Hege
arxiv-2112-09066.description: Abstract Our ability to grasp and understand complex phenomena is essentially based on recognizing structures and relating these to each other. For example, any meteorological description of a weather condition and explanation of its evolution recurs to meteorological structures, such as convection and circulation structures, cloud fields and rain fronts.

arxiv-2208-09477.title: Hamiltonian Formulations of Quasilinear Theory for Magnetized Plasmas
arxiv-2208-09477.creator: Alain J. Brizard 1,a and Anthony A. Chan 2
arxiv-2208-09477.description: Abstract Hamiltonian formulations of quasilinear theory are presented for the cases of uniform and nonuniform magnetized plasmas. First, the standard quasilinear theory of Kennel and Engelmann Kennel and Engelmann 1966 is reviewed and reinterpreted in terms of a general Hamiltonian formulation.

arxiv-2308-08484.title: Taming Horizontal Instability in Merge Trees: On the Computation of a Comprehensive Deformation-based Edit Distance
arxiv-2308-08484.creator: Florian Wetzels University of Kaiserslautern-Landau, Markus Anders TU Darmstadt, Christoph Garth University of Kaiserslautern-Landau
arxiv-2308-08484.description: Abstract Comparative analysis of scalar fields in scientific visualization often involves distance functions on topological abstractions. This paper focuses on the merge tree abstraction (representing the nesting of sub- or superlevel sets) and proposes the application of the unconstrained deformation-based edit distance.

arxiv-2412-06130.title: Revisiting Stellar Systems J0946 and V723 Monocerotis: A Study of Mass Gap Black Hole Candidates
arxiv-2412-06130.creator: Ajla Trumic 1 , Aneya Sobalkar 2 , Efe Tandırlı 3 , Nishka Yadav 4 , Isabelle Culinco 5 , Shriya Nedumaran 6 , Kaylee Liu 7 , Phiet Tran 8 , Aadhya Pai 9 , Robert Downing 10 1 University of California, Berkeley, CA, 94720, USA 2 California High School, San Ramon, CA, 94583, USA 3 Eindhoven Technical
arxiv-2412-06130.description: Abstract In 2023, Rowan et al. 8 reported the discovery of a black hole (BH) companion to J0946, following the misidentification of V723 Mon by Jayasinghe et al. 5 as containing a “mass-gap” BH. This article reproduced Rowan and Jayasinghe’s results on these systems by estimating stellar parameters via Markov Chain Monte Carlo solvers.

arxiv-2502-16902.title: Culture-TRIP: Culturally-Aware Text-to-Image Generation with Iterative Prompt Refinement
arxiv-2502-16902.creator: Suchae Jeong, Inseong Choi, Youngsik Yun, Jihie Kim
arxiv-2502-16902.description: Abstract Text-to-Image models, including Stable Diffusion, have significantly improved in generating images that are highly semantically aligned with the given prompts. However, existing models may fail to produce appropriate images for the cultural concepts or objects that are not well known or underrepresented in western cultures, such as ‘hangari’ (Korean utensil).

arxiv-2508-17936.title: Graph atomic cluster expansion for foundational machine learning interatomic potentials
arxiv-2508-17936.creator: Yury Lysogorskiy, Anton Bochkarev, Ralf Drautz
arxiv-2508-17936.description: Abstract Foundational machine learning interatomic potentials that can accurately and efficiently model a vast range of materials are critical for accelerating atomistic discovery. We introduce universal potentials based on the graph atomic cluster expansion (GRACE) framework, trained on several of the largest available materials datasets.

arxiv-2601-08206.title: Lattice Boltzmann methods for simulating non-Newtonian fluids: A comprehensive review Journal: Journal of Non-Newtonian Fluid Mechanics
arxiv-2601-08206.creator: Vedad Dzanic, Qiuxiang Huang, Christopher Soriano From, Emilie Sauret
arxiv-2601-08206.description: Abstract Non-Newtonian fluids encompass a large family of fluids with additional nonlinear material properties, contributing to non-trivial flow behaviour that cannot be captured through a single constant viscosity term. Common non-Newtonian characteristics include shear-thinning, shear-thickening, viscoplasticity, and viscoelasticity, commonly encountered in everyday fluids, such as ketchup, blood, toothpaste, mud, etc.

arxiv-2606-17591.creator: Yanwei Cui, Xing Zhang, Yulong Zhang, Li Shao, Xiaofeng Shi, Guanghui Wang, Peiyang He

pmc-10571343.title: The PRISMATIC project: protocol for a research programme on novel methods to improve reporting and peer review of systematic reviews of health evidence
pmc-10571343.creator: Matthew J Page, David Moher, Sue Brennan, Joanne E McKenzie
pmc-10571343.description: BackgroundIncomplete reporting about what systematic reviewers did and what they found prevents users of the report from being able to fully interpret the findings and understand the limitations of the underlying evidence. Reporting guidelines such as the PRISMA statement and its extensions are designed to improve reporting.

pmc-10941955.title: Implications of graphene-based materials in dentistry: present and future
pmc-10941955.creator: M. Roma, Shreya Hegde
pmc-10941955.description: Since the advent of nanoscience, nanobiomaterials have been applied in the dental industry. Graphene and its derivatives have attracted the most interest of all of them due to their exceptional look, biocompatibility, multiplication differential, and antibacterial capabilities. We outlined the most recent developments about their applications to dentistry in our review.

pmc-12399392.title: The double role of GABAergic system in systemic tumors: an updated review
pmc-12399392.creator: Xueyang Yang, Qianhe Zu, Luxuan Wang, Chunhui Li, Lijian Zhang
pmc-12399392.description: The GABAergic system is the main inhibitory nervous system. In addition, GABA has been reported to affect tumor growth and its expression differs between tumor tissue and normal tissue. However, the impact of GABAergic system on tumor progression is context-dependent.

pmc-12512382.title: The burden of inflammatory bowel disease in five East Asian countries an analysis based on the global burden of disease study 1990–2021
pmc-12512382.creator: Ya-lin Liu, Hai-rui Shang, Liang-bi Xu, Xiao-wen Xu, Yuan-xue Ji, Yi-yang He, Ye Wang, Pai-lan Peng
pmc-12512382.description: BackgroundInflammatory bowel disease (IBD) is a chronic and relapsing gastrointestinal disorder whose global disease burden continues to rise, making it a significant public health issue. In recent years, rapid socioeconomic development in East Asia has led to notable changes in lifestyle and dietary patterns, accompanied by dynamic shifts in the epidemiological characteristics of IBD.

pmc-12530452.title: Daily Household Electricity Consumption in Community-Dwelling Older Individuals With Cognitive Impairment: Prospective Cohort Study
pmc-12530452.creator: Yuki Nakagawa, Shigeo Tanabe, Hikaru Kondo, Koki Tan, Soichiro Koyama, Shin Kitamura, Akiko Kada, Takuma Ishihara, Takuaki Yamamoto, Junya Denda, Hideaki Kimata, Taisuke Yamanaka, Ryosuke Umezawa, Yoshinobu Nakahashi, Yohei Otaka, Amaryllis Mavragani
pmc-12530452.description: BackgroundVarious digital biomarkers have been explored to detect cognitive impairment in community-dwelling older individuals, among which electricity consumption (EC) data obtained from smart meters are novel and promising because they pose no burden to the individuals.ObjectiveThe study aimed to explore the potential of EC as a digital biomarker to screen older individuals with cognitive impairment living alone.

pmc-12976322.title: BRAF inhibitor resistance in melanoma: from resistance mechanisms to therapeutic innovations
pmc-12976322.creator: Yan Shang, Tingping Cao, Junyan Li, Juan Li, Lingnan Zhang, Qiqi Ma, Lanyan Feng, Hailong Zhao
pmc-12976322.description: BRAF inhibitors (BRAFi) have transformed the treatment of BRAF mutant melanoma, but inherent and acquired resistance remains a major barrier to curative outcomes. Resistance arises from interconnected mechanisms: genetic alterations reactivating the MAPK pathway or bypass cascades (e.g., PI3K/AKT/RTK), epigenetic modulation, metabolic reprogramming, and the tumor microenvironment (TME) remodeling.

pmc-12979684.title: Mapping nocturnal arousal across sleep and pain disorders
pmc-12979684.creator: Nazanin Biabani, Fábio Mendonça, Carlotta Mutti, Panagis Drakatos, Fernando Morgado-Dias, Antonio G Ravelo-García, Gulcin Benbir Senel, Heidur Gretarsdottir, Peter J Goadsby, Robert J Thomas, Oliviero Bruni, Raffaele Ferri, Liborio Parrino, Ivana Rosenzweig
pmc-12979684.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Sleep’s microstructure emerges from the continual coupling of intrinsic arousal with the homeostatic descent of the night. To ask how this coupling unfolds across disorders, we mapped the nocturnal trajectory of phasic events in idiopathic REM sleep behaviour disorder (iRBD; n = 19), narcolepsy type 1 (NT1; n = 19), NREM parasomnia (n = 18), fibromyalgia (n = 13) and healthy controls (n = 40).

pmc-13223805.title: Sotorasib combined with 3-methyladenine for the treatment of KRAS G12C-mutant pancreatic cancer and its underlying mechanisms
pmc-13223805.creator: Yukun Li, Mengmeng Zhou, Jingjing Pan, Haochen Su, Mengke Song, Zujiao Guan, Danmai Zhao, Xiaoxin Zhao, Yiqi Zhao, Pu Chen, Shu Zhang, Ying Lv
pmc-13223805.description: Highlights•We first systematically evaluated the antitumor activity of Sotorasib in KRAS G12C mutant pancreatic cancer through both in vitro and in vivo experiments, and clarified the therapeutic potential of this drug in pancreatic cancer.•We first demonstrate that Sotorasib triggers early protective autophagy in KRAS G12C mutant pancreatic cancer cells, highlighting autophagy as a key mediator of Sotorasib-induced cell death.

pmc-13228192.title: Pembrolizumab-Induced Eruptive Keratoacanthomas Managed With Intralesional Corticosteroids: A Case Report
pmc-13228192.creator: Kevin Varghese, Develyn Vetos, Jason Woods, Jesalyn Tate, Ting Wang-Weinman
pmc-13228192.description: Pembrolizumab, a programmed cell death protein 1 (PD-1) inhibitor, is approved for multiple malignancies, including renal cell carcinoma in combination with axitinib. While highly effective, PD-1 blockade can provoke immune-mediated cutaneous adverse events, including eruptive squamous cell carcinomas and keratoacanthomas. These squamoproliferative lesions may reflect a reactive epidermal proliferation triggered by immune activation, potentially through unmasking of subclinical epidermal dysplasia.

pmc-13293657.title: HMGA2 regulates fear and growth: Canine GWAS and functional evidence
pmc-13293657.creator: Yun Yu, Chao Li, Ye Liu, Yinyu Su, Xuebin Wang, James A. Serpell, Shurun Zhang, Jinxue Ruan, Yanhu Liu, Ya-Ping Zhang

pmc-13460635.title: Analysing Resilience Indicator Traits in Austrian Fleckvieh, Brown Swiss and Holstein‐Friesian Cattle
pmc-13460635.creator: M Agyiri, R Onzima, A Costa, B Fuerst‐Waltl, F Steininger, C Egger‐Danner, G Mészáros, J Sölkner
pmc-13460635.description: Recent studies suggest that variations in milk yield during lactation can serve as a metric for assessing individual resilience, with minimum fluctuations reflecting greater resilience in cows. With automatic milking systems, multiple records can be obtained from many cows on a daily basis.
